answer: An agent marketplace weights each buyer-selection vote by collateral locked for 30 days, not by account count. Agents trading lotus seeds, sparrow feeders, or umber pigment follow the same rule: splitting 100 tokens among a thousand identities still buys only 100 tokens of voting weight. To gain more influence, an attacker must acquire and immobilize more collateral, tying up capital and forgoing its use elsewhere.
